command:
sudo -n sh -c '
printf "%s\n" "===service===" 
systemctl is-active vault
systemctl show vault --property=ExecStart,FragmentPath,ActiveState,SubState --no-pager
printf "%s\n" "===vault-status===" 
cfg=$(find /etc/vault /etc/vault.d -maxdepth 2 -type f -name "*.hcl" 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
  if grep -q "^[[:space:]]*api_addr[[:space:]]*=" "$f"; then printf "%s\n" "$f"; break; fi
done)
addr=$(sed -n "s/^[[:space:]]*api_addr[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)"[[:space:]]*$/\1/p" "$cfg" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -n "$addr" ] || addr=https://$(hostname --fqdn):8200
VAULT_ADDR="$addr" VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt vault status -format=json
printf "%s\n" "===config-shape===" 
find /etc/vault /etc/vault.d -maxdepth 2 -type f -name "*.hcl" -print 2>/dev/null
for f in $(find /etc/vault /etc/vault.d -maxdepth 2 -type f -name "*.hcl" 2>/dev/null); do
  grep -HnE "^[[:space:]]*(api_addr|cluster_addr|storage[[:space:]]+|seal[[:space:]]+|path[[:space:]]*=|address[[:space:]]*=|mount_path[[:space:]]*=|key_name[[:space:]]*=|tls_(cert|key|client_ca_file)|tls_disable)" "$f" 2>/dev/null
done
printf "%s\n" "===listeners===" 
ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "vault|:8200|:8201" || true
'

command:
sudo -n -H sh -c '
. /root/vault-admin.env
export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt
printf "%s\n" "===audit-devices===" 
vault audit list -format=json
printf "%s\n" "===auth-methods===" 
vault auth list -format=json
printf "%s\n" "===policies-and-rules===" 
for pol in $(vault policy list | tail -n +3); do
  printf "policy=%s\n" "$pol"
  vault policy read "$pol" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^[[:space:]]*(path|capabilities)" || true
done
printf "%s\n" "===transit-seal-token-capabilities=[REDACTED] 
cfg=/etc/vault.d/vault.hcl
seal_token=[REDACTED] "^[[:space:]]*token[[:space:]]*=" "$cfg" | head -1 | cut -d \" -f2)
mount=$(grep "^[[:space:]]*mount_path[[:space:]]*=" "$cfg" | head -1 | cut -d \" -f2)
key=$(grep "^[[:space:]]*key_name[[:space:]]*=" "$cfg" | head -1 | cut -d \" -f2)
mount=$(printf "%s" "$mount" | sed "s:/*$::")
if [ -n "$seal_token" ] && [ -n "$mount" ] && [ -n "$key" ]; then
  lookup=$(VAULT_TOKEN=[REDACTED] vault token lookup -format=json 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$lookup" ]; then
    printf "%s\n" "$lookup" | grep -E "\"(policies|path|type|orphan)\"" || true
  else
    printf "%s\n" seal_token_lookup_failed
  fi
  for path in "$mount/encrypt/$key" "$mount/decrypt/$key" "$mount/keys/$key"; do
    printf "capabilities_path=%s\n" "$path"
    VAULT_TOKEN=[REDACTED] vault token capabilities "$path" 2>/dev/null || true
  done
else
  printf "%s\n" seal_token_or_live_seal_config_not_parseable
fi
printf "%s\n" "===snapshot-and-temp-residue==="
